links.comparator_used: Traditional diagnostic resources (clinicians without the custom GPT collaborative workflow)
links.effect: AI-first 85% and AI-second 82% vs 75% with traditional resources (p < 0.0004 and p < 0.00001; mean differences 9.8% and 6.8%; 95% CI 4.6%–15% and 4.0%–9.6%)
links.quote: Clinicians using either collaborative workflow outperformed those using traditional tools, achieving average accuracies of 85% (AI-first) and 82% (AI-second), compared to 75% with traditional resources (p < 0.0004 and p < 0.00001; mean differences = 9.8% and 6.8%; 95% CI = 4.6%–15% and 4.0%–9.6%).

design_hint: AI-first vs AI-second collaborative diagnostic workflow with clinician review
